AccountLinkInfo.description_en: The account information associated with the user

authentication_type.description_en:
The account type. Valid values:

mobile: mobile phone number
email: email address
ding: DingTalk
ram: Alibaba Cloud RAM user
wechat: WeCom
ldap: LDAP account
custom: custom account
authentication_type.description_zh:
账号类型

mobile：手机号

email：邮箱

ding：钉钉

ram：阿里云RAM子账号

wechat：企业微信

ldap：LDAP账号

custom：自定义账号
authentication_type.title: 账号类型

created_at.description_en: The time when the account was created. The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp starting from January 1, 1970, 00:00:00
created_at.description_zh: 账号创建时间，从1970年1月1日0点到现在的毫秒时间戳
created_at.title: 账号创建时间

display_name.description_en: The display name of the account. This name is displayed on the user interface. For example, the unique identifier of an LDAP account is the UID, but the name displayed to the user can be an employee ID or other information
display_name.description_zh: 账号显示名，用于界面上展示的名称，比如LDAP账号唯一标识为uid，但是展示给用户看的可以选择工号或其他信息
display_name.title: 账号显示名

extra.description_en: The additional information of the account. When the account type is mobile phone number, this field indicates the country code. For example, the country code for the Chinese mainland is 86. Currently, this field is returned only for mobile phone numbers
extra.description_zh: 账号附加信息，当账号类型为手机号时，此字段表示国家编码，比如中国大陆为86，当前只有手机号才返回此字段
extra.title: 账号附加信息

identity.description_en: The unique identifier of the account
identity.title: 账号唯一标识

last_login_time.description_en: The last time the account was used to log on. The value is a millisecond-level UNIX timestamp starting from January 1, 1970, 00:00:00
last_login_time.description_zh: 账号最后一次登录的时间，从1970年1月1日0点到现在的毫秒时间戳
last_login_time.title: 账号最后一次登录的时间

user_id.description_en: The user ID that corresponds to the account
user_id.title: 账号对应的用户ID

AccountLinkInfo.title: A short description of struct

description_en: Obtain account information by user ID
description_zh: 根据用户ID获取账号信息
name: GetLinkInfoByUserId
